items.title: edenfunf/reelmimic
items.summary: Show it a video you love. Get a new video in the same style. An AI crew (Claude Code or Codex) plans, builds and reviews it with you.

items.why_zh: 展示 AI 代理协作进行视频风格迁移，降低创作门槛。

items.title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
items.summary: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
items.summary_zh: 使用 Claude Code 及 fal MCP 进行游戏逆向、资产生成、测试等全流程 MOD 制作。
items.why_zh: 表明大模型可直接参与游戏逆向与内容创作，为工程师提供新范式。

items.title: yetone/magpie
items.summary: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
items.summary_zh: 菜单栏工具统一管理多种 AI 代理模型，如 Codex 在 DeepSeek、Claude Code 在 Kimi 上运行。
items.why_zh: 提供便捷切换与监控多模型代理的入口，提升开发效率。

items.title: Louis-CFM/coucou
items.summary: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.
items.summary_zh: 小巧的 Mac 菜单栏 / iPhone 小组件实时监控 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理，支持从锁屏或刘海批准。
items.why_zh: 让工程师能即时监督并干预 AI 编码行为，提升安全与可控性。

items.title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
items.summary_zh: 在消费级 RTX 4090 上运行 125B 参数的 Qwen 3.8 Flash Next，达到每秒 100 Token。
items.why_zh: 表明大模型可在单卡消费级硬件上实现高吞吐，降低部署成本。

items.title: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 将用户日记内容上报警方，导致该女子面临重罪指控。
items.why_zh: 提醒 AI 工程师注意模型使用中的隐私与合规风险，避免法律纠纷。

items.title: Optimizing the Optimizer: Language Models Discover Faster Molecular Relaxation
items.summary: Geometry optimization is a major cost in many quantum-chemical workflows: each optimization step requires one force evaluation, and at the density-functional level that evaluation dominates the wall time. Research in this area has produced a broad range of optimization methods, and we ask whether a language model can improve on the best of them through autoresearch. An agent rewrites the optimizer itself to minimize force-call counts, restrained by two admission gates that reject premature stopp
items.summary_zh: 语言模型自主重写优化器，以加速量子化学中的几何弛豫过程。
items.why_zh: 表明LLM能自动改进传统优化算法，为高成本量子计算提供潜在加速方案。

items.title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
items.summary: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sus
items.summary_zh: 提出三T原则框架，指导构建能在用户未请求前主动提供有用支持的LLM代理。
items.why_zh: 为主动Agent设计提供理论基础，帮助工程师平衡实用性与信任成本。

items.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Reka 发布 19B 参数全模态模型 Rho-1，统一处理文本、图像、视频并输出机器人动作。
items.why_zh: 展示单一Transformer通过共享KV缓存实现多模态推理，为端到端机器人控制提供新范式。

items.title: Meet the New Codex CLI
items.summary: Take a look at the latest Codex CLI updates and the refreshed terminal experience. Follow a walkthrough of the new interface and ways to work with Codex.

items.why_zh: 该设计提升了长时任务的可维护性和性能，为构建稳定的 AI 系统提供参考。

items.title: Build faster with Ultrafast
items.summary: Ultrafast is our fastest way to build with Astra yet: in Codex, it runs up to 8x faster than Astra Standard and 4x faster than Astra Fast. Bring your ideas to life as fast as you can type them.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 Ultrafast，在 Codex 中比 Astra Standard 快 8 倍、比 Astra Fast 快 4 倍，极速实现想法。
items.why_zh: 大幅提升代码生成速度，显著缩短 AI 应用原型开发周期，对工程师提效有直接影响。

Good (1965) , where he defined an “ultraintelligent machine” as a system that can surpass humans in all intellectual activities and design better machines to improve itself. Yudkowsky (2008) used the phrase “recursive self-improvement” for a specific feedback loop: an AI uses its current intelligence to improve the cognitive machinery that produces its intelligence. dups.why_zh: 帮助工程师理解并设计具备自我优化能力的 agent 系统，推动长期性能提升。
